title: The Clever Red Fox
body: Red foxes are among the most adaptable mammals on Earth. Found across the northern hemisphere, these orange-furred hunters use their bushy tails for balance and warmth. They can hear a mouse under three feet of snow.

title: Understanding the Gray Wolf
body: Gray wolves are pack animals that once roamed across most of North America. Their thick fur ranges from white to black, with the classic gray being most common. A wolf pack is led by an alpha pair that mates for life.

title: Choosing the Right Family Dog
body: Golden retrievers are among the most popular family dogs worldwide. Their friendly temperament and patience with children make them ideal companions. Regular exercise and grooming keep these dogs healthy and happy.

title: Grizzly Bears in the Wild
body: Grizzly bears are powerful omnivores found in North American forests and mountains. They can weigh over 600 pounds and run at 35 miles per hour. Despite their size, they are excellent swimmers and climbers.

title: The Graceful White-Tailed Deer
body: White-tailed deer are common across North American woodlands. Their distinctive white tail flags up as an alarm signal. Bucks grow antlers annually, shedding them each winter before regrowing larger ones in spring.
